description: Flat record-level metadata schema for compounds isolated from traditional medicinal plants, identified by chromatography/spectroscopy, and evaluated in cellular assays for antioxidant and anti-inflammatory bioactivity to support nutraceutical standardization and health-claim evidence.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this compound-level metadata record.

plant_scientific_name.descr: Accepted scientific name of the source medicinal plant (genus, species, and author if available).

plant_common_name.descr: Common or vernacular name of the source plant, if known.

plant_family.descr: Taxonomic family of the source plant.

plant_part_used.descr: Plant part analyzed or extracted (e.g., leaf, root, bark, flower, seed).

traditional_medicinal_use.descr: Traditional medicinal use or ethnopharmacological indication associated with the plant material.

geographic_origin.descr: Country, region, or locality where the plant material was collected.

collection_date.descr: Date when the plant material was collected.

voucher_specimen_id.descr: Herbarium or voucher specimen identifier for taxonomic verification.

extract_id.descr: Identifier for the crude extract or fraction from which the compound was isolated.

extraction_solvent.descr: Solvent or solvent mixture used for extraction (e.g., ethanol, methanol-water 80:20).

extraction_method.descr: Method used to obtain the extract (e.g., maceration, Soxhlet, ultrasound-assisted extraction).

isolation_method.descr: Method used to isolate the compound from the extract (e.g., preparative HPLC, flash chromatography, column chromatography).

chromatographic_techniques.descr: Chromatographic techniques used in isolation/analysis (e.g., HPLC, UPLC, GC-MS, TLC, LC-MS).

compound_name.descr: Assigned name of the isolated compound.

compound_class.descr: Chemical class of the compound (e.g., flavonoid, alkaloid, terpenoid, phenolic acid).

compound_identifier.descr: External or internal identifier for the compound, such as CAS number, PubChem CID, or lab code.

molecular_formula.descr: Chemical molecular formula of the identified compound.

molecular_weight.descr: Molecular weight of the compound in g/mol.

structural_description.descr: Brief structural annotation or key substructures if useful for interpretation.

spectroscopy_methods.descr: Spectroscopic methods used for structural elucidation (e.g., NMR, MS, IR, UV-Vis, CD).

purity_percent.descr: Estimated purity of the isolated compound expressed as percent (%), if measured.

yield_mg.descr: Mass of purified compound obtained, in milligrams (mg).

yield_percent.descr: Yield of purified compound relative to starting material or extract, expressed as percent (%), if available.

assay_type.descr: Bioactivity assay type used to evaluate the compound (e.g., DPPH, ABTS, ORAC, nitric oxide inhibition, cytokine inhibition).

cell_line.descr: Cell line or cellular model used in the assay (e.g., RAW 264.7, THP-1, HaCaT, HepG2).

target_pathway_or_endpoint.descr: Measured biological endpoint or pathway (e.g., ROS scavenging, NO production, TNF-alpha inhibition, NF-kB suppression).

assay_concentration_uM.descr: Test concentration of the compound in micromolar (uM), if the assay was performed at a fixed concentration.

ic50_uM.descr: Half-maximal inhibitory concentration in micromolar (uM), if determined.

ec50_uM.descr: Half-maximal effective concentration in micromolar (uM), if determined.

percent_inhibition.descr: Observed inhibition or scavenging percentage at the stated assay concentration, expressed as percent (%).

replicate_count.descr: Number of experimental replicates used for the reported bioactivity result.

statistical_summary.descr: Summary of statistics for the assay result, such as mean +/- SD, mean +/- SEM, or confidence interval.

positive_control_name.descr: Reference compound used as a positive control in the assay, if applicable.

positive_control_value.descr: Observed bioactivity value for the positive control under the same assay conditions, with units matching the main endpoint.

anti_oxidant_property.descr: Boolean flag indicating whether the compound showed antioxidant activity in the reported assay context.

anti_inflammatory_property.descr: Boolean flag indicating whether the compound showed anti-inflammatory activity in the reported assay context.

health_claim_relevance.descr: Boolean flag indicating whether the compound or record is being used to support nutraceutical health-benefit claims.

standardization_marker_candidate.descr: Boolean flag indicating whether the compound is considered a candidate marker for standardizing a nutraceutical product.

notes.descr: Free-text notes on assay conditions, identification caveats, isomerism, or other interpretive details.
